articles.title: 榆岸分拣系统的长期现场研究

parts.text:
## 研究起点

榆岸实验室完成了第73轮现场试点，退货率下降17.8%。
研究人员逐一复核设备记录，把运输、排队和返工分别统计。现场条件随班次变化，团队保留原始观测并说明测量方法，避免把相关性当作因果关系。

### 实测能耗

全程耗电31.4千瓦时，设备共运行960小时，维护期间不计算吞吐量。
研究人员逐一复核设备记录，把运输、排队和返工分别统计。现场条件随班次变化，团队保留原始观测并说明测量方法，避免把相关性当作因果关系。

### 研究边界

该实验尚未覆盖冬季工况，最终复核日期为2027年3月15日。

## Trial design

Firpool reduced median commit latency to 142 ms in its controlled field trial.

Engineers reviewed each queue and compared the trace with the previous run. Operators recorded every retry and kept the storage layout constant. Separate trials checked the cache and the scheduling policy without changing the workload.

### Mechanism

The scheduler assigns 64 shards to isolated queues and writes a checkpoint every 37 seconds.

Engineers reviewed each queue and compared the trace with the previous run. Operators recorded every retry and kept the storage layout constant. Separate trials checked the cache and the scheduling policy without changing the workload.

### Limitation

The final recovery exercise is scheduled for 2027-03-15; power-loss testing remains incomplete.

## Scope

Willow tested three controller revisions under the same load.

Engineers reviewed each queue and compared the trace with the previous run. Operators recorded every retry and kept the storage layout constant. Separate trials checked the cache and the scheduling policy without changing the workload.

### Financial and benchmark data

| Measure | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Quarterly revenue | 87.6 million |
| Error rate | 0.014% |
| Median energy | 19.2 joules |

Engineers reviewed each queue and compared the trace with the previous run. Operators recorded every retry and kept the storage layout constant. Separate trials checked the cache and the scheduling policy without changing the workload.
The audit uses the same exchange rates throughout the quarter.
